readout_other: Resting-state fMRI (GSA, ReHo, FC); diffusion MRI structure-function correspondence (R2)
direction_notes: Both protocols increased structure-function coupling near the mPFC; a significant increase across the default mode network occurred only after the excitatory protocol.
safety_notes: Skin temperature monitored and held at 35.4 C; no participants reported auditory confounding or other side effects.

exposures.label: Excitatory and suppressive tFUS protocols to mPFC

timing.protocol_description: Excitatory: 0.5 ms pulses at 1400 Hz (70% DC) in 300 ms pulse trains (420 pulses) separated by 5 s. Suppressive: 0.5 ms pulses at 100 Hz (5% DC) in 300 ms trains (30 pulses) with no inter-train interval (continuous pulsing). Trains repeated over a 20-min session.

source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: shared an operating frequency of 250 kHz, a pulse duration (PD) of 0.5 msec and a pulse train duration (PTD) of 300 msec
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.manufacturer: applied using an NS-US100 system (Neurosona, Seoul, Korea)
source_quotes.exposures[0].device.model: applied using an NS-US100 system (Neurosona, Seoul, Korea)
source_quotes.n_subjects: Of the total 21 participants with mean age of 54.4 year-old, including 9 males and 12 females, seven were assigned to each stimulation protocol: excitatory stimulation $( n = 7 ; \mathrm { a g e } = 5 4 . 9 \pm 6 . 5 $ years; 3 males, 4 females), suppressive stimulation $( n = 7 ; \mathrm { ~ a g e ~ } = 5 4 . 3 \pm 6 . 2$ years; 3 males, 4 females), and sham stimulation $( n = 7 ; \mathrm { a g e } = 5 4 . 1 \pm 6 . 3 $ years; 3 males, 4 females).
source_quotes.n_sessions_per_subject: The DMN modulation observed in this study represents acute changes following a single session of tFUS administration.

flags.reason: Two protocols at the same target and frequency are recorded as lists in order [excitatory, suppressive]; same order for duty cycle and in situ Ispta.
Pulse train duration 300 ms; the whole session was 20 min of repeated trains.
Table labels Isppa 'in situ' but the text says only 'determined based on acoustic calibration'; method of derivation not stated, so method is not_reported.
Values 525 and 38 mW/cm2 converted to W/cm2; ordered [excitatory, suppressive], not a min-max range.
Sham stimulation is described only as a sham tFUS group; mechanism not stated.
Participants were reported afterwards as having no auditory confounding; no control during the experiment.

Excitatory protocol increased structure-function correspondence in the default mode network; suppressive effect on the DMN was unclear; whole-brain activity tended to increase after excitatory and decrease after suppressive.
